text:
maria: Quick sync — thinking about Decision Replay UX for automatic fallback policies. Main questions: who gets to open a replay, what metadata shows up, and how do we avoid exposing sensitive request data? :eyes:

sanjay: Can we scope by org/team role? e.g. only SRE + account admins see full payloads; others see redacted summary.

olivia: retention and sampling matter. We can't store every decision at full fidelity. Proposal: full-fidelity for 7d for incidents, sampled 1% for 90d, and aggregated metrics longer-term.

ben: API debate: do we surface replay endpoints in public customer APIs or keep internal-only? If public, customers could automate audits but risk leaking internal routing context. Thoughts?

carla: Security note — default must redact PII. Also need an approval flow for exporting replays. If a replay contains user prompt text we should mask unless customer has opt-in. :lock:

maria: Agreed on defaults. UX sketch idea: Decision row with columns: time, route, reason code, score, TTL, small "view" chevron. View opens a drawer with a short trace + breadcrumbs. Full replay behind an "Access request" button if redacted.

olivia: Minor UI detail: show a redaction badge and list which fields were redacted. Helps trust. Also show sampling tag: `sampled` vs `full`.

ben: For the API side I'm leaning internal-only v1 and a controlled v2 for customers with `replay.read` scope. Keeps recoil low. We should include `replay_id` in webhook events for customers to link.

maria: Example policy payload (internal) I mocked:
```
{
  "policy_id": "auto-fallback-v3",
  "decision": "fallback_to-small-model",
  "reason": "latency_spike",
  "replay_id": "r-20240321-9bf",
  "sensitive": ["user_prompt"],
  "redacted": true
}
```
This would render summary in UI and hide `user_prompt` unless access granted.

carla: Also require audit trail entries for when someone requests access + who approved. Retain that for 1 year.

audit-bot: incident 2024-03-21T12:04Z — replay r-20240321-9bf created by policy engine (sampled). metadata={"route":"us-west-1","latency_ms":1320}.

sanjay: Operational ask: we need a compact playback mode for quick triage (no logs, just decision tree) and a full playback mode for postmortems. Keep both in UI.

maria: Implementation notes for eng: add flags: `replay.full_retention_days`, `replay.sample_rate`, `replay.redaction_profile`. Console should show these on policy details. Can someone propose reasonable defaults?

olivia: Defaults from infra POV: `full_retention_days=7`, `sample_rate=0.01`, `redaction_profile=default-ml` (masks prompts and tokens).

ben: I'll follow up with a short PR for API surface (internal-only endpoints + opt-in customer endpoint) and an auth spec for `replay.read` and `replay.export`.

maria: Thanks — action items: Ben PR for API, Olivia hook up sampling metrics + UI flags, Carla wiring for approval audit entries. I'll draft UX microcopy for redaction and access request flows. Ping me for quick sync. :thumbsup:
